passage:
Every weekend, an old man paints pictures on the sidewalk near the train station. His pictures disappear when it rains, but he keeps painting.
A student named Ben asked him, "Why do you make art that cannot stay"
The old man smiled and said, "A song does not stay in the air, but people still sing."
Ben watched him draw a blue whale swimming across the gray sidewalk. People stopped, took pictures, and smiled before walking away.
That night, rain washed the whale away. The next morning, only a few blue marks remained.
Ben felt sorry, but the painter did not. He had already started drawing a forest. He knew that something short can still be beautiful.
